transcript: If you don't have 5 Lacs in your bank account, you should not be allowed to do these 5 things. Number 1, Talk to Girls. Ek ladki patane mein tumhe minimum 2 hours per day invest karna padta hai. If you invest the same 2 hours in these side hustles, you can easily make extra 50,000 rupees a month. Comment "Side Hustle" and I'll teach you. Number 2, Watch News. Why do you care ke konsa protest hora hai ya phir Modi kya kar raha hai, huh? It's not like you can help, right? Because you don't have money, so first help yourself, and then help your country. Number 3, Attend Family Events. Indian gharo mein har hafte koi chota ya bada event hota hai. You meet the same people, you do the same gossip, and stay in the same small mindset. Instead, use that time to expand your mind by learning these skills. Number 4, Drinking with Friends. 1 night of drinking will cost 5,000 rupees and ruin the next 2 days of your life. So why not use that same time and money with those same friends to start a business together and make extra money? Number 5, Budgeting and Finance. You clearly are not good at making financial decisions, so why not let a pro handle it? Finance With Sharan's 1% Club app has an AI CFO, which tells you how you can save more in taxes, and it looks at your income, expenses, and savings, and tells you where you need to stop spending money. If you want to grow your money, it gives you personalized recommendation of where you should invest. Comment "CFO" if you want it in your DMs.
